text: A股零售、食品等消费股继续活跃，青岛食品6连板，合百集团、百大集团、国芳集团涨停，广百股份、一鸣食品、南方乳业等纷纷走高。
text_en: A-share consumer stocks such as retail and food remained active, with Qingdao Food posting a sixth consecutive limit-up, Hefei Department Store Group, Baida Group and Guofang Group hitting the limit, and Guangbai Co., Yiming Food, Southern Dairy and others rising.
